latest_packaged_runtime.summary: Runtime 033089b packaged 25 Nov as HIVE_Connected_Runner_033089b.zip: type a goal, HIVE plans with typed capabilities, finds a missing step, gets one local-model proposal checked 24/24 by an independent evaluator, admits it with a signature and reuses it after restart with zero model calls.

operational_readiness.title: Connected Goal Runner
operational_readiness.summary: Usable locally on one Windows host: goals for convert, merge and inventory-diff through the console; the learning loop ran once on one real workload and ties a scripted baseline (mechanism, not advantage); trusted local scope, not production-approved; Level A not accepted, Level B untested; $120 is the final project spending ceiling.
